title: Renormalization of the axial current operator in dimensional regularization at four-loop in QCD
claim: Renormalization constants of the singlet and non-singlet axial current with a non-anticommuting gamma5 in DR to four loops in QCD, derived from the off-shell Ward-Takahashi identity for the axial current; application to non-decoupling mass logarithms in axial quark form factors.
scheme: DREG + MS-bar, non-anticommuting gamma5 (Larin-type) with finite renormalization

assumed: the axial WT identity (with anomaly) as defining condition for the finite parts

notes: Lead corrected: the paper is four-loop, not five-loop.
